name: Hedra
summary: Generative video models for expressive character video.
description: Hedra builds generative video models and a platform to create expressive, character-driven videos such as talking avatars with lip-sync from an image and audio. It focuses on characters and performance rather than general scenes. A free tier ($0) is listed on its pricing page, with paid plans adding credits, higher resolution and commercial use.

pricing.label: Freemium
pricing.note: A free tier ($0) is listed on its pricing page, with paid plans adding credits, higher resolution and commercial use.

howToUse.title: Create an account
howToUse.description: The homepage starts with Create an account and Get the API.

howToUse.title: Get an API key
howToUse.description: Managed inference hosts the models. The page says there are 100+ models and that Hedra handles hosting.

howToUse.title: Fine-tune, or use a sandbox
howToUse.description: The page says you can fine-tune a supported model with your data and Hedra's training recipes, then deploy on the same stack, or create an isolated GPU sandbox with the Hedra SDK.
